fields.orderHint: Lower comes first in the template menu. {default} is the default — go below it to lift a design to the front, above it to sink one to the back.
fields.planEmpty: No package plans are available right now.

colors.empty: No colors yet. Add one below.

fonts.empty: No fonts yet. Add one below.
fonts.sizeScaleHint: Scales this font's glyphs so the showcase text sizes suit it. Every face renders at a different visual size for the same setting, Khmer faces especially. 1x leaves the font exactly as drawn.

calibrate.matched: Matched. Adjust from here if you want it larger or smaller.
calibrate.unavailable: Could not measure this font. Set the size by eye instead.

upload.title: Upload a font
upload.licenseHint: Shown to the admin reviewing your template. Worth filling in.
upload.hint: TTF, OTF, WOFF or WOFF2, up to 5MB. Only you can see and use the fonts you upload.
upload.errorExtension: Fonts must be a .ttf, .otf, .woff or .woff2 file.

transitionStage.animationHint: Picks how the cover gives way and which transition follows it: decorations slide off and the invitation is unveiled, or the cover splits into two doors that swing open.
transitionStage.videoHint: Plays after the cover, before the invitation appears. Used only when the event has no video of its own.

coverHint.animation: The cover is a still backdrop that animates away on the tap — decorations sliding off, or the doors swinging open.
coverHint.video: The cover is a looping film, playing full-bleed behind the guest name.

transitionHint.animation: The Save the Date card over the event's featured photograph. Events with no featured photo go straight from the cover to the invitation.
transitionHint.video: A film playing full screen between the cover and the invitation — the event's own video, or the one uploaded below.

backgroundHint.animation: A still photograph behind the invitation, falling back to the template colour.
backgroundHint.video: A looping film behind the invitation.

hint.split: Left and right end caps with a middle that repeats to fit the name. Best for art that tiles.
hint.single: One image is the whole frame. It keeps its aspect ratio and scales with the name.
hint.corners: Corner ornaments only, with nothing drawn between them. Two uploads fill all four corners.

guestFrame.cornersHint: Each corner draws Corner A, Corner B, or nothing. Use the flips to reuse one image on the opposite side.
guestFrame.sourceMissing: No image uploaded for this slot yet

coverLayout.showWelcomeHeaderTextHint: Render the welcome header text on the showcase.
coverLayout.showCoverHeaderTextHint: Render the cover header text row. When off, the logo row absorbs that height.
coverLayout.showHostNameUnderLogoHint: Render the host name below the logo on the showcase.
coverLayout.hostClipHint: Position of the host image clipped into sample_logo_2's shape (% of clip square).

fallingEffect.enableHint: Animated petals, confetti, snowflakes, etc. Shown on the main content stage.
fallingEffect.customImageHint: Transparent PNG or SVG, 64–128 px, under 20 KB. Overrides the built-in shape.

ambientCreatures.enableHint: Butterflies, doves, fireflies, dragonflies, balloons, hummingbirds drifting across the cover stage.

coverGilding.enableHint: Lights the edge of the cover artwork: a raised bevel, two travelling highlights and corner glints. Best on artwork that already has a printed border to catch the light.
coverGilding.reliefHint: Casts a shadow under the four cover decorations so they sit above the artwork. The shadow follows each image's shape, so transparent PNGs work best. Raised is strong — check it over a pale cover before shipping.
coverGilding.bandWarning: The inner edge must sit further in than the outer edge, or there is no band to light. The default band is used until it does.
coverGilding.sparkMovedHint: Drifting sparks are configured in the Effects tab — they span the whole showcase, so they are no longer part of this border lighting.
coverGilding.cornerFlaresHint: Pulsing light on the border's four corners.

sparks.enableHint: Blinking motes of light that drift across the whole showcase — the cover, the transition and the main content, as one unbroken field.
sparks.sizeHint: Sizes are a percentage of the stage width, so sparks keep their proportions on any screen. Each spark picks a random size in this range.
sparks.customImageHint: Transparent PNG or SVG, 64×64 to 128×128, under 20 KB. Replaces the built-in shape and is drawn as-is, so the tint setting no longer applies.

eventDetailsDesign.designHint: Controls how the event date and location are displayed in the showcase.
eventDetailsDesign.markerColorHint: Colour of the design's one accent mark — the calendar's circled day, the flanked rules, the arch outline, the ticket perforation. Pick a template colour that stands out against the background.

infoCardDesign.designHint: Controls how the venue, map, countdown and RSVP block is presented. Engraved is drawn in the same hairline language as the calendar, flanked and arch date designs.

saveTheDateDesign.designHint: The title card on the transition stage, between the cover and the invitation. Both transition types render all six — match the transition to keep each on the design it was drawn for.

types.columns: Columns (large day, month and year either side)

agendaDesign.designHint: How the schedule under the invitation is drawn. The event category still picks the wording — a funeral shows a Ceremony Schedule — so this is purely the look.

types.milestone: Milestone (centred stops, best for long titles)
types.ledger: Ledger (time column, hairline rules, most compact)

dressCodeDesign.designHint: How the attire block is drawn. Every design lays out each time of day and each gender rather than hiding them behind tabs, and draws the outfit as a garment in the colour the organizer picked — so a dress code with no photograph still looks finished.

types.portrait: Portrait (framed figures side by side) — the safe default
types.atelier: Atelier (hairline arch, tracked type name) — formal
types.spread: Spread (unframed figure beside its copy) — long descriptions
types.palette: Palette (a row of colour discs) — birthdays, themed
types.ledger: Ledger (one line per code, nothing hidden)

hostInfoDesign.designHint: Controls how the host information is displayed in the showcase.
hostInfoDesign.frameHint: One choice, drawn twice - around the host title and around their avatar, so the pair always match. Standard and Portrait only; Arch brings its own frames and Simple has neither.
hostInfoDesign.ornamentHint: Drawn in the column between the two hosts, beside their photos.

footer.missingRequired: Add a name and a package plan to save.
footer.autosaveHint: Changes preview live; nothing is saved until you save.
